public_body: Fall River Solid Waste Task Force
overall: The AG found the Fall River Solid Waste Task Force was not a public body under the Connelly exception, because the Mayor created it solely to advise him on a decision he alone makes. No violation for the unposted May 7 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Solid Waste Task Force held its May 7 meeting without posting notice as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Mayor created the Task Force solely to advise him in making this decision, we find that the Task Force falls within the Connelly exception to the definition of "public body" and was therefore not subject to the Open Meeting Law.
